_doc: THE SERVER-SIDE HALF OF THE LANDING GATE — vibe-ic, 2026-08-29.
Apply with:
gh api -X POST repos/vibeic/vibe-ic/rulesets \
--input tools/ci/main_landing_ruleset.json
Read back with:
python3 tools/ci/main_ref_protection_check.py --live
WHY THIS FILE IS IN THE TREE AND NOT ONLY IN THE SETTINGS PAGE
A ruleset is configuration: it lives outside the repository, nothing in
the tree references it, and deleting it is one API call that leaves no
commit, no diff and no reviewer. That is the exact shape of the failure
this file answers. Keeping the intended document tracked gives the rule a
diffable definition, and main_ref_protection_check.py gives it a reader.
bypass_actors IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY. The people able to skip the lane are
exactly the people who did; an org-admin bypass entry would reinstate the
hole while looking closed. Changing the rule stays possible and becomes an
AUDITABLE act rather than a keystroke on a push.
required_status_checks NEEDS NO GITHUB ACTIONS. Actions is disabled at the
account level for this org (measured: actions/permissions ->
{"enabled": false}), and the appeal was rejected. The context below is
fed by the Commit Statuses API from tools/ci/landing_status_publish.py,
which gatekeeper-land.sh calls at the same two places it writes and
removes the stamp.
MEASURED REFUSAL (probe ref refs/heads/enforce-probe/**, 2026-08-29):
rule active, sha carries NO status    -> git push             EXIT 1
rule active, sha carries NO status    -> git push --no-verify EXIT 1
rule active, sha carries the status   -> git push             EXIT 0
rule DELETED, same statusless commit  -> git push             EXIT 0
remote: - Required status check "vibe-ic/landing-lane" is expected.
THE LANDING PROCEDURE GAINS ONE STEP, because a status cannot be posted
for a commit the server does not have (measured: HTTP 422 'No commit found
for SHA'). So: push the sha to any non-main ref first, let the lane post
the status, then push to main.
HONEST LIMIT: status:write travels with push access, so the same person
can forge the status. This makes an ACCIDENTAL skip impossible and a
deliberate one a separate, visible act. It is not a cryptographic
guarantee, and closing that gap needs a GitHub App credential the lander
does not hold.
name: main-requires-the-landing-lane
